generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential integers starting at max(compact key)+1, step 1, unique per table; never NULL. For parent tables with compact IDs 0..7 the generated IDs are 8,9,10,...; for OBJ_CLASSES (compact max 298) generated IDs are 299,300,...; for PRED_CLASSES (compact max 149) generated IDs are 150,151,...; for ATT_CLASSES (compact max 7) generated IDs are 8,9,10,...
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Draw from the parent table's actual row tuples (compact + generated), never from independent column lists; allow NULL only if the column is nullable; leave at least one parent key unreferenced so parent rows without children exist; for composite FKs draw the whole tuple from the parent's real (col1,col2) pairs grouped by the shared column.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_measure: Uniform integer in [0, 1000] unless a range rule narrows it; include boundary values at listed literals and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.text_label: Sample from a small pool of short lowercase words; include near-variants (case changes, trailing/leading spaces) at listed equality literals; allow duplicates on DISTINCT columns.
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: Sample from the explicit enum list only.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For nullable columns, generate at least one NULL row per instance and a NULL share matching the compact database (0% observed for IMG_OBJ.OBJ_CLASS_ID, X, Y, W, H); the atomic summary's 5-30% target for IMG_OBJ.OBJ_CLASS_ID is intentionally overridden in favor of the compact share, with at least one NULL row emitted and preserved (never overwritten by dedupe or FK redraw).
generic_sampling_rules.tie_share: For ORDER/LIMIT columns, ensure at least two rows share the same COUNT(*) value at the listed rank.
generic_sampling_rules.duplicate_share: For DISTINCT columns, ensure 20-50% of rows share a value with another row.
generic_sampling_rules.group_sizes: For columns with group_sizes targets, draw FK values so that groups of size 1, 2 and >=3 appear; assign distinct parent keys per target size and do not shuffle in a way that merges same-key groups.
generic_sampling_rules.table_size: Each table generates exactly the base size in table_sizes_per_instance per instance (no randomization); aggregate-boundary targets depend on exact group sizes.
